name: INheritage: Boundary of Existence
source:
"This is a tale of those who watch over us"
"This is a battle that won't be written in our history"
"This is a fight that we will never know about"
"This is a story of those who exist in the boundary of existence"

This is just one from many unwritten tales about them. Arca. Those who were chosen to protect their respective city and the balance of the world by sending back Yaksa, the half-god being from other world, to their own world. With power given by the Tree of Life, Kalpataru which, and guided by city's spirit, Rakyan, They will always watch over us. Even now.

Being chosen as Arca of Bandung after an incident that killed her and her best friend 2 years ago. Nala continue her new live; living as a high-school girl and at the same time protecting her city as Arca. But one day, The Kalpataru roots which supporting the barrier between two worlds in Bandung suddenly disappeared. To protect her city, Nala has to find out a what's really happen before the whole city thrown into abyss. But then, she realize that this crisis is bigger than she expected.

[From [url=http://tinkerworlds.com/inheritage/#!/page_Story]The Official website[/url]]

Inheritage: Boundary of Existence is an exciting shooter game based on Indonesian culture elements. Packed with beautiful artworks, Inheritage is an innovative game with gorgeous gesture motion, interesting visual novel and enchanting voice actors on your iphone!

Defeat various mythical enemies and dodge hell bullet storms to help Nala through her journey!

[From [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/inheritage-boundary-existence/id636344466?ls=1&mt=8]iTunes[/url]]
translation:
“这是那些守望着我们的人的故事。”
“这是一场不会被写进历史的战役。”
“这是一场我们永远不会知晓的斗争。”
“这是那些存在于存在边界之上的人的故事。”

这只是关于他们的无数未被记载的故事之一。他们是阿尔卡：被选中守护各自的城市与世界平衡的人。他们将来自异世界的半神夜叉送回原本的世界，凭借生命之树“如意树”赐予的力量，在城市之灵拉基安的指引下，始终守望着我们。此刻也不例外。

两年前，一场事故夺走了娜拉和她挚友的生命。在那之后，她被选为万隆的阿尔卡。娜拉继续着新的生活，既作为一名高中女生生活，也作为阿尔卡守护自己的城市。然而，有一天，支撑万隆两界之间屏障的如意树根突然消失了。为了保护城市，娜拉必须在整座城市坠入深渊之前查明真相。但她随即发现，这场危机远比自己预想的更大。

[摘自[url=http://tinkerworlds.com/inheritage/#!/page_Story]官方网站[/url]]

《传承：存在之界》是一款以印度尼西亚文化元素为基础的精彩射击游戏。精美的画面、华丽的手势动作、引人入胜的视觉小说剧情，以及动听的配音，共同构成这款创新游戏，让你在iPhone上体验其中的魅力！

击败各种神话中的敌人，躲过铺天盖地的弹幕，帮助娜拉完成她的旅程！

[摘自[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/inheritage-boundary-existence/id636344466?ls=1&mt=8]iTunes[/url]]
